units.source_text: 我收拾好了男人，就出去跟女人说，她丈夫似乎的了急症，让她快去瞅瞅。

en.t: After I had dealt with the man, I went out and told the woman that her husband seemed to have fallen suddenly ill and that she should hurry and look at him.
Of course, she fell for it too.

units.source_text: 女人摘掉了带着面纱的市女笠，我拉着她的手把她骗进竹林深处。

en.t: The woman took off her veiled ichimegasa hat, and I took her by the hand and lured her deep into the bamboo grove.

units.source_text: 女人一看他丈夫被捆在杉树脚上——不知何时，她从怀里掏出一把闪亮的小刀，刀已出鞘。

en.t: As soon as the woman saw her husband tied at the foot of a cedar, before I knew it, she had drawn a gleaming little knife from inside her robe, already out of its sheath.

units.source_text: 我还是头一次见这么厉害的女人！

en.t: It was the first time I had ever seen such a fierce woman.

units.source_text: 那时候我只要一不小心，就会被她一刀捅进肚皮。

en.t: At that moment, if I had been careless for even an instant, she would have stabbed me in the belly with one thrust.

units.source_text: 没有，就算逃过了这一刀，她乱刀挥舞，我真不好说会受什么伤呢。

en.t: No, even if I had dodged that one thrust, with her slashing wildly, I truly cannot say what wounds I might have suffered.

units.source_text: 不过我是多襄丸啊，大刀都没使，就把她的小刀打落在地。

en.t: But I am Tajomaru, after all; without even using my long sword, I knocked her little knife to the ground.

units.source_text: 再怎么厉害的女人，没有武器也无可奈何了。

en.t: No matter how formidable a woman may be, without a weapon she can do nothing.

units.source_text: 按照原计划，我在不杀害男人的前提下，霸占了这女人。

en.t: Just as I had planned, I forced myself on the woman without killing the man.
